'''Oxidized Copper Door''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from [[Weathered Copper Door]] +<br />{{MCW|Potion}}) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from [[Oxidized Copper]]). See {{MCW|Oxidized Copper Door}} for everything else.
